svg.aria-label: One prefill layer as data flow, and one CTA of the grouped NVFP4 expert GEMM: a producer warp loads weight and token tiles by TMA into a 4-stage shared-memory ring, consumer warps decode the weights in registers to BF16 as the A operand of wgmma with the token tile as B in shared memory, and copier warps store the output
svg.text: one CTA, 16K expert kernel, down projection
